hydration.name: A glass of water
hydration.description: Keep a glass by your notebook and sip as you go.

exercise.name: A short walk
exercise.description: Ten minutes of fresh air, with no pressure to go far.

sleep.name: Wind down for bed
sleep.description: Put the pen down and head to bed at a kind, steady time.

reading.name: A few pages of a book
reading.description: Read a little each evening, just for the pleasure of it.

mindfulness.name: Five quiet minutes
mindfulness.description: Sit with a cup of tea and simply notice how you feel.

screentime.name: Phone down after supper
screentime.description: Set it face-down for the evening and see what fills the space.

diet.name: One good thing on the plate
diet.description: Add something fresh to a meal. Small, tasty, easy.

other.name: A daily tick
other.description: One small thing to tick off each day, just for you.
